discovery_notes: Follow-up 7 of B007 (packets 207, 413, 456, 489, 513, 534, 554); reuses their keys. 29 standard searches, snippets only. New pin: HKDL CNY 2019 Three Little Pigs LE 500 (held, summary-only). Release evidence (quoted captions): CNY Minnie & Daisy, 14th Minnie; Sneezy name confirmed by DPB list. Added HK$148 prices (Genie key, PIN-GO Eeyore/Roo, summaries), Sept 2019 set count 9. Recurring HKMSG LE400 vs DPB LE300 split on keys (Marie, Genie, Bo Peep). December eight, Nov 2019, SHDR monthly 6-10, Spring booster, 3rd anniv, Ant-Man, Graduation still unresolved. Carousell, USShoppingSOS, dpinstore not used.
